name: @pipeworx/mcp-ipqualityscore

tools.name: check_ip
tools.description: Fraud detection & risk scoring for an IP address. Answers "is this IP a proxy, VPN, or Tor exit node?", flags bots/crawlers and recent abuse, and returns a 0-100 fraud score plus geolocation (country, region, city, ISP, connection type). Example: check_ip({ ip: "8.8.8.8", strictness: 1 }) Requires your own IPQualityScore API key, passed as _apiKey.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to check, e.g. "8.8.8.8"

strictness.description: Detection strictness 0, 1, or 2. Higher = more aggressive proxy/VPN detection (more false positives). Default 1.

_apiKey.description: Your own IPQualityScore API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free tier at ipqualityscore.com; the key is on the account dashboard.

tools.name: check_email
tools.description: Email fraud & deliverability check. Validates an email address, detects disposable/temporary addresses, flags emails seen in data leaks, and returns a 0-100 fraud score plus deliverability, SMTP, and DNS validity signals. Example: check_email({ email: "user@example.com" }) Requires your own IPQualityScore API key, passed as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own IPQualityScore API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free tier at ipqualityscore.com; the key is on the account dashboard.

tools.name: check_phone
tools.description: Phone number validation & fraud check. Confirms whether a number is valid and active, returns a 0-100 fraud score, and flags VOIP, prepaid, and risky numbers with line type, carrier, and region. Example: check_phone({ phone: "18007267864", country: "US" }) Requires your own IPQualityScore API key, passed as _apiKey.

phone.description: Phone number to validate, e.g. "18007267864" or "+1 800 726 7864"

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code to improve parsing, e.g. "US", "GB".

_apiKey.description: Your own IPQualityScore API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free tier at ipqualityscore.com; the key is on the account dashboard.

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: URL / malware safety scan. Checks whether a URL or domain is unsafe — phishing, malware, spam — and returns a risk score, domain reputation rank, content category, DNS validity, and domain age. Example: check_url({ url: "https://example.com" }) Requires your own IPQualityScore API key, passed as _apiKey.

url.description: Full URL or domain to scan, e.g. "https://example.com"

_apiKey.description: Your own IPQualityScore API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free tier at ipqualityscore.com; the key is on the account dashboard.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ipqualityscore forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ipqualityscore pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
